note: Extension axes appended after the base 607 (post-fingerprint, additive; same guarantee as the pure-interjection senses). All values non-negative. Filled only by closed-class lexicon entries (quantum_parser/lexicons/<lang>.json); content words have no value on them. Owner decision 2026-11-15.

axes.name: KNOWN
axes.meaning: 0 = not marked as identifiable / 1 = the hearer can identify the referent (the, this, he, it, my)

axes.name: UNKNOWN
axes.meaning: 0 = not asked / 1 = the speaker lacks this and asks for it (who, what, where, when, why, how)

axes.name: GOAL
axes.meaning: 1 = the end of a movement or purpose (to, into)

axes.name: SOURCE
axes.meaning: 1 = the start of a movement (from, out, off)

axes.name: AND
axes.meaning: 1 = plain conjunction, adding one thing to another (and, but)

axes.name: MALE
axes.meaning: natural gender of a person: male (he, him, his)

axes.name: FEMALE
axes.meaning: natural gender of a person: female (she, her)
